description: Address critical code review issues: REST/HTTP API event format mismatch, registration race condition, and DynamoDB pagination gaps.
steps: Update src/handlers/auth.py to route using event['httpMethod'] and event['resource'] instead of event['routeKey']
Add ConditionExpression='attribute_not_exists(username)' to put_item in auth.py _register() and handle ConditionalCheckFailedException
Update src/handlers/entries.py to route using event['httpMethod'] and event['resource'] instead of event['routeKey']
Add LastEvaluatedKey pagination loop in entries.py _list_entries()
Update src/handlers/search.py to route using event['httpMethod'] and event['resource'] instead of event['routeKey']
Add LastEvaluatedKey pagination loop in search.py _search_entries()
Update tests/helpers.py make_event() to generate REST API proxy format events (httpMethod + resource instead of routeKey)
Run tests and verify all pass
acceptance_criteria: All handlers route on event['httpMethod'] and event['resource'] (REST API format)
Registration put_item uses ConditionExpression to prevent username overwrites atomically
Both _list_entries and _search_entries handle DynamoDB pagination via LastEvaluatedKey
Tests use REST API event format and all 22+ tests pass
verification: Run: cd /projects/sandbox/multi-user-journal-app/infra && source /root/.nvm/nvm.sh && npx aws-cdk@latest synth 2>&1 | tail -10
findings: All 22 tests pass after switching to REST API event format. CDK synth still succeeds. The ConditionExpression on put_item works correctly with moto mock - existing duplicate username test passes without changes. Pagination loops added for both entry listing and search queries.
